_about: The six real photos this repo ships, their scene, and work / do-not-touch zones placed BY HAND on 2026-10-21 (lane CT2010-OCV1 L1) by looking at each photo on a 10% grid. Not model output. Boxes are normalised [x0, y0, x1, y1], origin top-left, same convention as stepspotter.models.Box. Used by tests/test_perception*.py and eval/build_set.py.
_rights: Photos of Mikhail Oskola's own house, taken by him; published in the public StepSpotter repo with his permission on 2026-09-09. No people in frame except a hand in 05 and 06.
_split: Eval split is by SCENE, never by case: calibration = scene 'panel' (01, 02, 03); test = scenes 'office-jack' and 'dining-node' (04, 05, 06). Variants of one photo never land in both halves, and no case mixes photos from both halves.

01.name: 01-panel-overview
01.what: the structured-wiring panel from across the room, door off

step.title: Confirm the low-voltage panel
step.action: Open the panel and check there are only low-voltage cables in it.
step.evidence_required: the open structured-wiring panel in one wide frame, with no circuit breakers in it

02.name: 02-panel-inside
02.what: inside the same panel, closer: coax splitter, telecom module, cables

step.title: Find the coax splitter
step.action: Look inside the panel for the silver coax splitter.
step.evidence_required: the inside of the panel with the silver coax splitter and its cables visible

03.name: 03-telecom-module
03.what: close-up of the telecom module in the same panel, taken at a different time (cables moved)

step.title: Confirm the run lands at the module
step.action: Check the cable is punched down into one of the module's numbered ports.
step.evidence_required: a close-up of the telecom module with wire pairs punched into a numbered port block

04.name: 04-office-jack-front
04.what: a yellow keystone jack in a wall plate, straight on

step.title: Snap the jack into the plate
step.action: Push the keystone jack into the wall plate until it clicks.
step.evidence_required: the keystone jack seated flush in the wall plate, seen from the front

05.name: 05-office-jack-open
05.what: the same wall box opened, a hand holding the keystone jack out with wire pairs laid in

step.title: Lay the pairs into the jack
step.action: Lay the coloured wire pairs into the slots on the keystone jack.
step.evidence_required: the keystone jack held out of the open wall box with the coloured pairs laid into it

06.name: 06-dining-node-white-cable
06.what: a wall node by the router: a white cable from the wall into a white module, a hand holding it

step.title: Seat the cable in the module
step.action: Push the white cable into the white module by the router.
step.evidence_required: the white cable plugged into the white module next to the router
